description: The smallest possible Agent Space: one idling container, no storage, no prerequisites. Use it to check that the agent-sandbox controller is installed and reconciling.
notes: Upstream runs the container with no command, so the image entrypoint returns at once and the agent space settles on Completed instead of Running. This copy keeps the container alive with 'sleep infinity', the way other agent spaces do, so the agent space stays up and can be exec'd into.
